paper: AgentInit: Initializing LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems via Diversity and Expertise Orchestration for Effective and Efficient Collaboration
input: task description; generated/candidate roles and expertise
optimization_target: team composition balancing task relevance, expertise and diversity
needs_current_task_execution: not a post-hoc tracer; method generates/selects agents for task
benchmarks_or_scope: multiple MAS frameworks and tasks; see paper
closest_overlap: same research stage and role/team initialization
difference_from_rolecheck: AgentInit constructs the team; RoleCheck audits already initialized roles and predicts protocol-conditioned keep/repair value.

paper: Assemble Your Crew: Automatic Multi-agent Communication Topology Design via Autoregressive Graph Generation (ARG-Designer)
input: natural-language task query; extensible role pool
optimization_target: agent count, role selection and communication graph
needs_current_task_execution: design is conditioned on task; training/evaluation uses task outcomes
benchmarks_or_scope: six reasoning/coding benchmarks according to paper
difference_from_rolecheck: ARG-Designer creates team composition/topology; RoleCheck is a post-initialization audit layer that preserves the design unless reliable value evidence supports intervention.

paper: Multi-Agent Design: Optimizing Agents with Better Prompts and Topologies (MASS)
input: existing MAS blocks, prompts, workflows and task evaluations
optimization_target: local prompts, topology and global workflow prompts
intervention: multi-stage search over prompts and topology
benchmarks_or_scope: reasoning, multi-hop QA and code tasks; see paper
official_code: not verified from primary paper page as of 2026-08-01
closest_overlap: optimizes role prompts and system design
difference_from_rolecheck: MASS searches a broad design space; RoleCheck predicts which initialized role or finite repair candidate has positive marginal value and favors minimal intervention.

paper: MASPO: Joint Prompt Optimization for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
input: multi-agent prompts, interactions and task evaluations
optimization_target: joint refinement of prompts across the whole MAS
needs_failure_trace: no full failure trace requirement in abstract
benchmarks_or_scope: six diverse tasks according to paper
closest_overlap: role-specific prompt optimization with global outcomes
difference_from_rolecheck: MASPO jointly optimizes prompts; RoleCheck first estimates prospective keep and candidate-specific repair value, then edits selectively.

paper: MAS-PromptBench: When Does Prompt Optimization Improve Multi-Agent LLM Systems?
input: MAS setups varying in task, workflow, communication protocol and team size
needs_current_task_execution: yes, prompt optimizers are evaluated on tasks
intervention: applies multi-agent versions of prompt optimizers
benchmarks_or_scope: broad task and framework configurations; see appendices
official_code: paper page states project/code links; exact repository should be re-verified
closest_overlap: directly studies when MAS prompt optimization helps
difference_from_rolecheck: MAS-PromptBench evaluates prompt optimization broadly; RoleCheck focuses on value-guided admission/repair and when not to optimize.

paper: Optimizing LLM-Based Multi-Agent System with Textual Feedback: A Case Study on Software Development
input: task performance and textual failure feedback
needs_failure_trace: uses failure explanations/feedback, not necessarily long traces
intervention: locate underperforming agents then rewrite prompts
benchmarks_or_scope: software development case study with multiple evaluation dimensions
official_code: not confirmed from primary arXiv page as of 2026-08-01
difference_from_rolecheck: Closest conceptual competitor: RoleCheck must differentiate through prospective team-value prediction, finite candidate ranking, uncertainty and conservative abstention.

paper: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
uses_counterfactual: yes; replay and programmed fault injection for data construction
intervention: diagnostic feedback; downstream system improvement reported
benchmarks_or_scope: Who&When / TracerTraj; MetaGPT and MaAS applications
official_code: official repository not confirmed from primary arXiv page as of 2026-08-01
closest_overlap: auditing, actionable diagnosis and counterfactual terminology
difference_from_rolecheck: AgenTracer explains observed failures after execution; RoleCheck predicts potential role value before the current task full execution.

paper: Who Broke the System? Failure Localization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems (AgentLocate)
optimization_target: responsible agent and earliest decisive failure step
uses_counterfactual: not central in abstract; confidence-aware multi-perspective verification
benchmarks_or_scope: two failure-localization benchmarks according to paper
difference_from_rolecheck: AgentLocate localizes responsibility in completed failures; RoleCheck is a pre-execution role-value and intervention layer.

paper: Agents that Matter: Optimizing Multi-Agent LLMs via Removal-Based Attribution
optimization_target: agent contribution under specified coalition distribution, removal protocol and metric
benchmarks_or_scope: three benchmarks plus a medical MAS according to abstract
official_code: not confirmed from primary arXiv page as of 2026-08-01
closest_overlap: closest formal contribution target: protocol-dependent removal attribution
difference_from_rolecheck: It measures contribution through executed interventions; RoleCheck treats such values as labels/oracles and aims to predict them prospectively and use them for selective repair.

paper: Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration (CCPO)
input: collaborative trajectories and shared terminal rewards
optimization_target: agent-specific policy advantages and collaborative policies
uses_counterfactual: yes; outcome with agent contribution removed
benchmarks_or_scope: mathematical/logical reasoning; Think–Reason and voting topologies
closest_overlap: counterfactual marginal contribution at agent level
difference_from_rolecheck: CCPO uses counterfactual credit to train policies; RoleCheck predicts role value externally without optimizing the full policy.

paper: LEMON: Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
input: task, executable orchestration specification and execution reward
optimization_target: roles, duties, capacity levels and dependency structure
uses_counterfactual: yes; localized edits and reward contrasts
intervention: train orchestrator to generate executable team designs
benchmarks_or_scope: MMLU, GSM8K, AQuA, MultiArith, SVAMP, HumanEval
difference_from_rolecheck: LEMON trains a complete orchestration generator; RoleCheck audits externally generated teams and applies constrained role interventions.

paper: MAPRO: Recasting Multi-Agent Prompt Optimization as Maximum a Posteriori Inference
input: fixed-topology MAS prompts and task evaluations
official_code: not confirmed from primary source as of 2026-08-01
closest_overlap: multi-agent prompt optimization under inter-agent coupling
difference_from_rolecheck: MAPRO searches prompt configurations; RoleCheck predicts role-level keep and candidate-repair value and can abstain.

paper: Multi-agent Architecture Search via Agentic Supernet (MaAS)
closest_overlap: automatic MAS design and downstream enhancement
difference_from_rolecheck: MaAS searches architectures; RoleCheck audits an initializer output and limits changes to role-level minimal interventions.

paper: Contextual Counterfactual Credit Assignment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in LLM Collaboration (C3)
input: sequential collaborative transcripts and terminal reward
needs_failure_trace: uses full context/continuation replay, not failure-only traces
uses_counterfactual: yes; fixed-context alternatives and leave-one-out baseline
benchmarks_or_scope: mathematical and coding benchmarks according to paper
difference_from_rolecheck: C3 assigns credit to messages/actions in executed trajectories; RoleCheck predicts role-configuration value before current-task execution.
